plan_metadata.name: Feature DA No Action Add Microsoft Entra Auth Configurations

steps.description: Type the URL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/neil-yechenwei/uitest/refs/heads/main/Spec_add_auth_aad_tmp.yaml' into the file path input field at the top of the "OpenAPI Document" dialog in Visual Studio Code, within the Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit extension interface.
Press Enter to confirm the URL input in the "OpenAPI Description Document" address bar in Visual Studio Code.
Click the checkbox to select all operations in the "Select Operation(s) Copilot Can Interact with" dropdown in Visual Studio Code.
Click the "OK" button in the "Select Operation(s) Copilot Can Interact with" dropdown to confirm the operation selection in Visual Studio Code.
Click the "Default folder" option in the "Workspace Folder" dialog to select '/home/vscode/AgentsToolkitProjects' as the project location in Visual Studio Code.
Press the F1 key in the Visual Studio Code application to open the Command Palette from the main Explorer view.
Type 'Add configurations to Support' into the Visual Studio Code command palette input field at the top of the interface.
Press Enter to select "Microsoft 365 Agents: Add Configurations to Support Actions with Authentication" from the VS Code command palette.
Press Enter to confirm the selection of "ai-plugin.json" in the "Import Manifest File" dialog in Visual Studio Code.
Type "aadAuthCode" into the input field of the "Enter the Name of Auth Configuration" prompt at the top of the Visual Studio Code window.
Press the Enter key to confirm the input "aadAuthCode" in the "Enter the Name of Auth Configuration" prompt in Visual Studio Code.
Click on the "Microsoft Entra" option in the "Select an authentication type" dropdown within the "Authentication Type" dialog in Visual Studio Code.

Type text 'api://plugincb4aae.azurewebsites.net/4cfde729-32e4-4862-a409-07e14dbfd296/readpairs_read: Read repair records' into the input box of the "Enter the OAuth Scope" dialog in Visual Studio Code.
Press 'Enter' to confirm the selected OAuth scope input ("rebsites.net/.../repairs_read: Read repair records") in the VS Code command palette prompt.
Type the text '4cfde729-32e4-4862-a409-07e14dbfd296' into the Entra SSO client ID input field within the Visual Studio Code extension interface during the Provision workflow.
Press the Enter key to submit the Entra SSO client ID in the VS Code input prompt dialog.
Click the "4 New Notifications" icon in the bottom-right corner of the Visual Studio Code window to open recent alerts.
@assertion there is a button containing "Sign in"
